title: coix lacryma-jobi var. exaltata
intro: Coix lacryma-jobi var. exaltata, commonly known as Job's Tears, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae and is native to Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Job's Tears include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Job's Tears include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
